result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Corio may terminate on 30 days’ prior written notice without an early-termination charge and receives a refund of prepaid fees allocable to the post-termination period, while Commerce One receives no convenience-termination right during a committed term. It preserves the existing breach, insolvency, and renewal provisions. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” adds a partial-termination right not required by the playbook and therefore is broader than necessary. The language is otherwise professionally drafted.
